tickets.title: Obtain Term Life Reinstatement Requirements
tickets.text: Obtain the carrier's reinstatement requirements for Serena Willowdoodle's individual term life policy with Plum Zeppelin Life Insurance, whose bank draft failed after the family changed checking accounts and which no longer shows as in force in the carrier portal. Identify any interim underwriting or replacement quote information needed if reinstatement is unavailable.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that by 2025-04-08 the follow-up is to obtain the carrier’s reinstatement requirements and identify any interim underwriting or replacement quote information needed if reinstatement is unavailable.
